disclosures.subject: base year
disclosures.text: The frozen base year and its high-water-mark treatment are read from a verbal SME description and are not yet confirmed against the Georgia Job Tax Credit form.

disclosures.subject: tier
disclosures.text: Tier designations are prototype data covering four worksites. Units outside that registry are shown unassigned and fall back to the rule pack's minimum-new-jobs threshold.

disclosures.subject: credit amount
disclosures.text: Claimable dollars use one statutory amount per qualifying job. Tier-varied amounts are not authored in any rule pack, so a Tier 2 location is priced at the Tier 1 rate.

disclosures.subject: census tract
disclosures.text: Census tract is not held anywhere in the system and is left blank.

disclosures.subject: month coverage
disclosures.text: No pay period reaches the measuring date in TY2020 month 12, TY2021 month 12, TY2022 month 12, TY2023 month 12, TY2024 month 12, TY2025 month 12, TY2026 months 8/9/10/11/12. Those months read zero as a fact about the pay calendar, not about headcount, and are marked rather than counted as a decline.
